# Surface material credits

Photographic PBR materials from Poly Haven, released under CC0:

- Stone Brick Wall 001 — https://polyhaven.com/a/stone_brick_wall_001
- Wood Floor Worn — https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_floor_worn
- Rocky Terrain 02 — https://polyhaven.com/a/rocky_terrain_02
